ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-15-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: July 15, 2008

This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of three minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Leticia Garcia was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minors, who were not present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to: Andy Nicholas Cardenas, Alex Jayden Cardenas and Lety Rosalia Cardenas.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
